name: Apex Circuit
subtitle: The Apex Circuit iPhone app
description: Install Apex Circuit and get its updates. Free; signed on your phone with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: Apex Circuit
apps.subtitle: Karts to Grand Prix, on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription: A racing game for your phone: karts, F4, F3, F2 and Grand Prix cars on original and real-world circuits. Career from karts to Grand Prix, championships, time trials against friends' ghost laps, and races with friends online. Same game as the Android app; progress moves between them with a backup code.
